narrative.overview:
TailSplit uses the user-approved idy/magpie-design-system for its embedded desktop configuration panel: neutral system appearances, blue actions, Lato body copy, Montserrat actions and Monda headings. This shared system serves the local macOS and Windows panel; PRODUCT.md remains authoritative for networking, identity and authorization behavior.

The build vendors unmodified Magpie source at commit aefce96c4022b692bf7e2f4e05d64901a130964f (v0.4.2), including the extracted text-dropdown and preference-row variants. Shared tokens, fonts, document defaults, components and layout load before TailSplit’s product stylesheet. TailSplit owns native-host geometry, the centered workspace, exit selection, diagnostics and responsive integration. Preserve these incumbent decisions when extending the panel.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral surfaces that follow system appearance.
Shared typography, controls and radius scale from pinned Magpie assets.
Text-backed connection states and explicit draft confirmation.
Native window chrome and a centered, compact workspace.

rules.name: The Appearance Rule
rules.body: Use Magpie semantic properties so surfaces, text, controls and focus change together across appearances; keep the diagnostic terminal’s scoped dark palette.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: Pair semantic color with a readable label; saved, pending, selected, connected and unavailable are distinct states.

rules.name: The Shared Type Rule
rules.body: Use the bundled Magpie families and rem scale by role; reserve monospace for configuration and diagnostics.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tone and fine borders for ordinary panels; reserve ambient shadows for overlays and small control details.

dos: Do use Magpie semantic CSS properties for both system appearances.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior and accessible announcements.
Do allow English/Chinese labels and helper text to wrap while truncating node names with full-value titles.
Do preserve current and pending selections, draft protections and explicit confirmation.
Do keep shared dropdown interaction stable through unchanged state polls.
donts: Don't edit vendored Magpie assets to create local variants; keep product geometry and states in the product stylesheet.
Don't imply connection or saved configuration from selection styling alone.
Don't apply this panel system to the public website without inspecting that surface’s implementation.
